WITH lowest_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        y.CustomerID,
        y.Date,
        y.Consumption,
        c.Segment,
        c.Currency,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.Segment ORDER BY y.Consumption ASC) as rn
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
      AND c.Currency = 'CZK'
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        AVG(Consumption) as avg_consumption
    FROM lowest_consumption
    WHERE rn = 1
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') as SME_LAM_diff,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') as LAM_KAM_diff,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') as KAM_SME_diff
FROM annual_avg
